in_hebrew.name: Cosima
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Cosima הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Latin word cosmos, meaning order, arrangement, or harmony. In Christianity, the name Cosima is associated with the Roman martyr Cosima of Rome, who was a Christian virgin and was martyred during the persecution of Emperor Diocletian.
